resources.string: Let Plum sessions use this phone through the app — no adb, no pairing code. Plum reads the screen, taps, types and takes screenshots while you watch.
Lets Plum sessions read and operate this phone: read the screen, tap, type, scroll and take screenshots. No data leaves your Plum server.
This phone is connected to Plum and can be operated by your sessions.
Enable “Plum device control” in Android’s accessibility settings; the phone pairs itself.
Not enabled — accessibility service is off
Paused — sessions cannot use the phone
Allow sessions to control this phone
While connected, a notification shows that sessions can operate the phone. Keep this off to pause without turning the accessibility service off.
